basics.name: Binjie Zhang
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate, Computer Science
basics.summary: Fourth-year Ph.D. candidate at Show Lab, National University of Singapore, advised by Prof. Mike Zheng Shou. Research focuses on LLM agents, multimodal understanding, and continual / compatible learning. Four first-author or co-first-author conference papers at ICLR, IJCAI, AAAI, and ECCV; three production agent systems delivered at TikTok Shop within five months. Currently working on Agentic Search at TikTok Search.

work.name: TikTok Search (ByteDance)
work.summary: Agentic Search and Tako: scenario-aware agent policies, evidence-driven system iteration, and ongoing model-training design.
highlights: Led Auto-Skill policy iteration: failure diagnosis, bounded strategy changes, versioned experiments, and evaluation of the delivered search experience.
Developed scenario-specific prompts while preserving shared planning and response contracts.
Ongoing data work - faithful trajectories that distinguish model-visible evidence, agent actions, runtime repairs, and final rendered outcomes.
Ongoing training and evaluation design - compare SFT, reinforcement learning, and on-policy distillation; evaluate agent behavior and product quality separately.

work.name: TikTok Shop (ByteDance)
work.summary: Led FIRE, EvoA, and APA from design to production within five months, working with business and infrastructure partners on integration and rollout.
highlights: FIRE - designed a reusable skill-based agent harness with semantic routing, progressive context loading, and governed tool execution for e-commerce workflows.

EvoA - built an autonomous model-iteration loop combining diagnosis, pilot experiments, validation gates, and reusable experiment memory; reduced the human audit rate by approximately 4.6% relative in a controlled online experiment.

APA - built evidence-driven risk discovery using joint content / product signals, scoped expansion, deduplication, and provenance-aware review; expanded candidate throughput approximately 17-fold in workflow measurements.
Owned architecture, implementation, experimentation, evaluation, and cross-team integration.

work.name: Show Lab, National University of Singapore
work.summary: Research on grounded agent recovery, reliable supervision, evolving state, and continual model adaptation.
highlights: ReGRPO - grounded reflection and corrective tool use; accepted at ECCV 2026.
SGRC, StateTrackBench, and PathComp - first-author submissions under review at ICLR 2027.
POU-OPD - first-author submission under review at AAAI.
Four first-author or co-first-author conference papers across ICLR, IJCAI, AAAI, and ECCV; TaCA is an additional preprint.

work.name: Tencent ARC Lab - Compatible Representation Learning
work.summary: Backward-compatible representation learning and model upgrades for large-scale image and video retrieval systems.
highlights: First-author / co-first-author work at ICLR 2022, IJCAI 2022 (long oral), and AAAI 2023, plus the TaCA preprint.
Designed compatible model upgrades that accelerate production hot updates and reduce feature-refresh cost for image and video retrieval.
Built distributed contrastive / CLIP-style training pipelines and regression-alleviating compatible learning methods.
Recipient of the Tencent Technology Breakthrough Award and SZCCF Science and Technology Award.

work.name: Tencent ARC Lab - Cross-Modality Video Understanding
work.summary: Multimodal models for video-text retrieval and temporal grounding on large-scale video-language datasets; built the PyTorch data / training / evaluation codebase for the group's multi-modal research.

highlights: Advisor - Prof. Mike Zheng Shou (Show Lab).
Research on LLM agents, multimodal understanding, and continual / compatible learning.
Expected completion - January 2027.
Advisor - Prof. Chun Yuan.
Focus on compatible representation learning and cross-modal video understanding.
Excellent Master's Graduate in Beijing; Outstanding Master's Thesis.
